$schema_note: Objective, user-approved CRT rules. These have priority over repository assumptions and over any single latest message. See docs/CRT_MASTER_INSTRUCTION.md for the governing framework.

rules.rule: CRT is scanned on multiple anchors, each with its own confirmation TF: 4H range -> 15m confirm, 1D range -> 1h confirm, 1W range -> 4h confirm. All timeframes must be scanned, not only 4H.

Only an actively OPPOSING higher timeframe vetoes READY (never trade against the HTF narrative). A neutral/unclear higher TF is tolerated and costs score, not eligibility. Chain: 4H needs 1D+1W, 1D needs 1W, 1W needs 1M.
Killzones are confluence, not a veto. Inside a killzone adds probability/score; outside is never a blocker. TR sessions: Asia 02-05, London 09-12, NY 14-17, London Close 17-19.
There is no daily max-trade-count cap. The only hard daily brake is -2R.
News/high-impact-data windows do not block trades by default. Only a real news/spike (news-expansion) regime, or an explicit opt-in avoidNews flag, may gate.
The raid must land at a map POI: the swept level must coincide with a key level (PDH/PDL/PWH/PWL) or an HTF FVG. A random wick is not a raid. (Currently a quality note, not a hard veto.)
All user-facing text (search, waiting, alerts) must speak the signal's real confirmation TF (15m/1h/4h), never a hard-coded 15m.

The candle that mitigates the CRT range candle (the raid) does NOT have to close back inside before dropping to the LTF. A live raid whose reclaim holds is a valid setup basis; live and closed raids score equally.

The manipulation need not be the candle immediately after the range candle. The raid is the FIRST later candle that sweeps the range extreme; the candles in between must have stayed inside the range (accumulation).

ChoCH must be the FIRST close through the protecting swing, and it must land within a bounded window after the manipulation (CHOCH_MAX_DELAY_CANDLES=24 confirm candles). A later re-close of the same level is the new trend's BOS, not this raid's ChoCH.
Once price mid-fills the CRT range (EQ/50%) after the raid, the setup is consumed -> no fresh entry.

blockers.length === 0 is the single hard READY gate. The blocker list holds only true CRT-core invalidators; everything soft (no POI, PD not ideal, out of session, weak displacement, continuation-against, chop) is a quality warning that costs score, never vetoes.
Quality grade auto-sizes risk: A+ 1.0, A 0.85, B 0.55, C 0.30, D 0.15 of base risk. A loosened low-grade READY is still small size; only A+ takes full size.
Displacement after the manipulation is required for a tradable model, but a linked shift-FVG can substitute; medium/strong displacement scores, none is a quality note unless no shift FVG exists.

Range candles must be meaningful, not arbitrary. Hybrid (not a hard filter): every closed candle is a CANDIDATE, but reference_candle_score (Master Section 5) grades it. Components: imbalance body/range 0-30 (rejection < 0.3, strong >= 0.7), range vs ATR 0-25 (ideal 0.8x-2.5x, exhausted > 3.5x), expansion vs recent median 0-15, meaningful HTF location 0-20, key-open/killzone session 0-10. An A imbalance candle adds ~9 to the setup score, a D/arbitrary candle ~2; a D/C reference candle raises a quality warning; thresholds are configurable (referenceCandle.ts REFERENCE_CANDLE_DEFAULTS). Grounded in ict-knowledge-library CRT checklist, XAU-60 body/ATR/expansion filters, crt-turtlesoup-ea wick/body.
